description: This file defines a React functional component for managing search tools, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting search tools within a UI dashboard. It utilizes React hooks, React Query for data fetching, and Ant Design components for modals and forms.

classes.name: DeleteModal
classes.description: A React functional component for displaying a confirmation modal to delete a search tool.

classes.name: SearchTools
classes.description: Main React component for managing search tools, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting functionalities.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the search tool ID to delete and opens the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the selected search tool and refetches the list upon success.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal without deleting.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful creation of a new search tool, closing the modal and refetching data.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Validates and submits the edited search tool data to update the server.

methods.name: renderEditForm
methods.description: Returns the React JSX for the edit search tool form.
